autonomous_decisions.issue: Pi adapter attaches no `error` listener to `child.stdin`. If `engram` is missing (ENOENT) or exits before reading stdin, the `write`/`end` calls emit an async EPIPE or destroyed-stream error. That error is unhandled and can crash the host's extension process instead of failing open. The `child.on("error")` handler only covers spawn errors. Add `child.stdin.on("error", () => finish(""))` before the write.
